courses.title: Handling Your Fire: Passion, Burnout, Routines and Resilience
courses.description: A six-hour audiobook in which Rob Bell talks through what he has learned about giving yourself to the work you love without being left depleted. He works through four themes, passion, burnout, routines and resilience, with stories from his own life.
